issue_context.title: `scan_ipc` broken for Enum on new streaming engine
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [x] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [x] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
import os
import polars as pl

# Use new streaming
os.environ["POLARS_FORCE_NEW_STREAMING"] = "1"

# DataFrame with a an enum field
df = pl.DataFrame([["a"]], schema={"val": pl.Enum(["a"])})

# Write to a feather file
file_path = "test.feather"
df.write_ipc(file_path)

# This will fail
target_df = pl.scan_ipc(file_path).collect()
```


### Log output

```shell

```

### Issue description

Raises `polars.exceptions.SchemaError: type Categorical(Some(global), Physical) is incompatible with expected type Enum(Some(local), Physical)`

### Expected behavior

Would expect this to work

### Installed versions

<details>

```
--------Version info---------
Polars:              1.24.0
Index type:          UInt32
Platform:            Windows-11-10.0.22631-SP0
Python:              3.12.7 (tags/v3.12.7:0b05ead, Oct  1 2024, 03:06:41) [MSC v.1941 64 bit (AMD64)]
LTS CPU:             False
```

</details>
